RichDictionary.description: Settings for Umbraco.RichDictionary. The whole section is optional; without it the defaults apply.

EditorMode.description: The editor used for dictionary values, set once per site. 'Rte' edits with the Tiptap rich text editor and stores HTML; 'Markdown' edits and stores Markdown. An unrecognised value falls back to 'Rte' with a warning logged at startup.
